_comment: Paragraph gaps in message bodies (DATA_MODEL.md 「本文の形式」, 2026-10-05), the same in the three clients: markdown.ts paragraphLayout, MessageBodyView.swift BodyTokenizer.paragraphLayout, BodyTokenizer.kt paragraphLayout. One newline is a line break; one or more blank lines (a line of only spaces counts) are one paragraph gap of about 0.4 of a line, not empty lines. `paragraphs` lists the body's paragraph blocks in order (other blocks are left out): gap_before / gap_after = blank lines at its start / end (a gap to the block before / after), groups = the runs of lines between blank lines (as text). A paragraph of only blank lines has no groups and is drawn as one gap.

cases.name: a blank line between two lines is a gap
one newline stays a line break
several blank lines collapse into one gap
a line of spaces is blank
blank lines around a heading are gaps on both sides
only blank lines between two blocks: one gap
before a list and after a quote
a code block keeps its blank lines
